about: Default assumptions for the print_estimate 'estimate' route. Every value is a rule of thumb, not a measurement: override through the profile argument, or use a slicer route for real numbers.
source: 3D Agent toolbox rule of thumb (tb/make.py); no external standard

layer_height_mm.source: common 0.4 mm nozzle default layer height

line_width_mm.source: common extrusion width for a 0.4 mm nozzle

support.source: support counted only where overhanging faces exist

overhang_angle_deg.source: common FDM rule: overhangs steeper than 45 degrees from vertical need support

flow_mm3_s.source: average (not peak) volumetric rate: 0.45 mm x 0.2 mm bead at roughly 65 mm/s

time_overhead_factor.source: allowance for travel, retraction, acceleration and heat-up

filament_diameter_mm.source: most common FDM filament diameter; 2.85 mm also exists

likely_error.source: toolbox judgement; not validated against sliced G-code on this machine
